title: CR-BRK-011 — Customer Delete without Invoicing Delete — payment-delete boundary
preconds: Customers V/E/D \u2713 | Invoicing \u2717 | WO V \u2713 | View Mode: Full (View Mode as specified).
steps:
1. Configure a custom role per the Setup in Preconditions; assign to a test user and log in.
  2. Delete a customer record (allowed); attempt to delete a customer payment (must be blocked).
expected:
Customer Delete removes customer records only. Deleting a customer's PAYMENT requires Invoicing: Delete (§1d Delete note + §1h note). With no Invoicing, payment deletion must be blocked.

Risk / Rationale: Customer Delete cascades into payment deletion without Invoicing Delete — boundary not enforced.
Spec Ref: §1d Customer Delete; §1h note
